# 形式
# 機械語[スペース]マイクロコード[スペース]IDSC Reset Number[スペース]#コメント
# 同じ機械語に対応するマイクロコードは、連続した行に書く。飛び飛びに書いてはならない。
# マイクロコードと#の間のスペースは必ず開けること。

xxx0xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 000000000000000001111000 0 # IE=0 (during fetch)
0xx10000101111111111 000000011100000000111000 0 # jnc opd (Taken)
1xx10000101111111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jnc opd (Skip)
1xx10000110011111111 000000011100000000111000 0 # jc opd (Taken)
0xx10000110011111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jc opd (Skip)
x0x10000110111111111 000000011100000000111000 0 # jnz opd (Taken)
x1x10000110111111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jnz opd (Skip)
x1x10000111011111111 000000011100000000111000 0 # jz opd (Taken)
x0x10000111011111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jz opd (Skip)
xx010000111111111111 000000011100000000111000 0 # jns opd (Taken)
xx110000111111111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jns opd (Skip)
xx110001000011111111 000000011100000000111000 0 # js opd (Taken)
xx010001000011111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # js opd (Skip)

xxx10001000111111111 000000011100000000111000 0 # jmp opd
x1x10001011011111111 000000011100000000111000 0 # je opd (Taken)
x0x10001011011111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # je opd (Skip)
x0x10001011111111111 000000011100000000111000 0 # jne opd(Taken)
x1x10001011111111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jne opd(Skip)
x0010001100011111111 000000011100000000111000 0 # ja opd (Taken)
xxx10001100011111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # ja opd (Skip)
x0010001100111111111 000000011100000000111000 0 # jae opd (Taken)
x1010001100111111111 000000011100000000111000 0 # jae opd (Taken)
xxx10001100111111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jae opd (Skip)
x0110001101011111111 000000011100000000111000 0 # jl opd (Taken)
xxx10001101011111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jl opd (Skip)
x0110001101111111111 000000011100000000111000 0 # jle opd (Taken)
x1010001101111111111 000000011100000000111000 0 # jle opd (Taken)
xxx10001101111111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jle opd (Skip)
xxx10001001111111111 000001000000000001111000 1 # hlt
xxx10001010011111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # nop
xxxx1111111111111111 000000000000000001111000 1 # invaild
xxx10001010111111111 000000101000000001010000 1 # lpc

# --- 算術・論理演算 (add, sub, mul, and, or, xor, div) ---
# reg-reg
xxx100000000aaaabbbb 000010aaaa1bbb000aaaa000 1 # add r1, r2
xxx100000001aaaabbbb 000010aaaa1bbb001aaaa000 1 # sub r1, r2
xxx100000010aaaabbbb 000010aaaa1bbb010aaaa000 1 # mul r1, r2
xxx100000011aaaabbbb 000010aaaa1bbb011aaaa000 1 # and r1, r2
xxx100000100aaaabbbb 000010aaaa1bbb100aaaa000 1 # or r1, r2
xxx100000110aaaabbbb 000010aaaa1bbb110aaaa000 1 # xor r1, r2
xxx100000111aaaabbbb 000010aaaa1bbb111aaaa000 1 # shr r1, r2

# reg-opd
xxx100000000aaaa1111 000010aaaa1111000aaaa000 1 # add r1, opd
xxx100000001aaaa1111 000010aaaa1111001aaaa000 1 # sub r1, opd
xxx100000010aaaa1111 000010aaaa1111010aaaa000 1 # mul r1, opd
xxx100000011aaaa1111 000010aaaa1111011aaaa000 1 # and r1, opd
xxx100000100aaaa1111 000010aaaa1111100aaaa000 1 # or r1, opd
xxx100000110aaaa1111 000010aaaa1111110aaaa000 1 # xor r1, opd
xxx100000111aaaa1111 000010aaaa1111111aaaa000 1 # shr r1, opd

# reg-[memaddr+opd]
xxx100000000aaaa1001 00001010011aaa000aaaa010 1 # add r1, [memaddr+opd]
xxx100000001aaaa1001 00001010011aaa001aaaa010 1 # sub r1, [memaddr+opd]
xxx100000010aaaa1001 00001010011aaa010aaaa010 1 # mul r1, [memaddr+opd]
xxx100000011aaaa1001 00001010011aaa011aaaa010 1 # and r1, [memaddr+opd]
xxx100000100aaaa1001 00001010011aaa100aaaa010 1 # or r1, [memaddr+opd]
xxx100000110aaaa1001 00001010011aaa110aaaa010 1 # xor r1, [memaddr+opd]
xxx100000111aaaa1001 00001010011aaa111aaaa010 1 # shr r1, [memaddr+opd]

xxx10000000010111111 000010101111110001010000 1 # add memval,opd

# not
xxx100000101aaaa1111 000010aaaa1000101aaaa000 1 # not r1

# --- データ転送 (mov, in, out) ---
# mov r1, r2
xxx100001000aaaabbbb 000000bbbb0000000aaaa000 1 # mov r1, r2

# mov r1, [memaddr+opd]
xxx100001000aaaa1001 00000010010000000aaaa010 1 # mov r1, [memaddr+opd]
# mov memval, [memaddr+opd]
xxx10000100010111001 000000100100000001010010 1 # mov memval, [memaddr+opd]
# mov memaddr,r1
xxx1000010001010aaaa 000000aaaa00000001001000 1 # mov memaddr,r1
# mov memval,r1
xxx1000010001011aaaa 000000aaaa00000001010000 1 # mov memval,r1
# mov [memaddr+opd],memval
xxx10000100010101010 000000000000000001111011 1 # mov [memaddr+opd],memval
# mov memaddr,opd
xxx10000100010101111 000000011100000001001000 1 # mov memaddr, opd
# mov memval,opd
xxx10000100010111111 000000011100000001010000 1 # mov memval, opd


# mov r1, opd
xxx100001000aaaa1111 00000001110000000aaaa000 1 # mov r1, opd

# in / out
xxx100001001aaaa1111 00000010000000000aaaa000 1 # in r1
xxx100001010aaaa1111 000000aaaa00000001000000 1 # out r1
xxx10000101011111111 000000011100000001000000 1 # out opd


# --- 比較 ---
xxx100010010aaaabbbb 000010aaaa1bbb0011111000 1 # cmp r1, r2
xxx100010010aaaa1111 000010aaaa11110011111000 1 # cmp r1, opd


# jmp,jcc命令
xxx10001000110111111 000000101100000000111000 0 # jmp memval

0xx100001011aaaa1111 000000aaaa00000000111000 0 # jnc r1 (Taken)
1xx100001011aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jnc r1 (Skip)
1xx100001100aaaa1111 000000aaaa00000000111000 0 # jc r1 (Taken)
0xx100001100aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jc r1 (Skip)
x0x100001101aaaa1111 000000aaaa00000000111000 0 # jnz r1 (Taken)
x1x100001101aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jnz r1 (Skip)
x1x100001110aaaa1111 000000aaaa00000000111000 0 # jz r1 (Taken)
x0x100001110aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jz r1 (Skip)
xx0100001111aaaa1111 000000aaaa00000000111000 0 # jns r1 (Taken)
xx1100001111aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jns r1 (Skip)
xx1100010000aaaa1111 000000aaaa00000000111000 0 # js r1 (Taken)
xx0100010000aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # js r1 (Skip)
xxx100010001aaaa1111 000000aaaa00000000111000 0 # jmp r1
x1x100010110aaaa1111 000000aaaa00000000111000 0 # je r1 (Taken)
x0x100010110aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # je r1 (Skip)
x0x100010111aaaa1111 000000aaaa00000000111000 0 # jne r1(Taken)
x1x100010111aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jne r1(Skip)
x00100011000aaaa1111 000000aaaa00000000111000 0 # ja r1 (Taken)
xxx100011000aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # ja r1 (Skip)
x00100011001aaaa1111 000000aaaa00000000111000 0 # jae r1 (Taken)
x10100011001aaaa1111 000000aaaa00000000111000 0 # jae r1 (Taken)
xxx100011001aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jae r1 (Skip)
x01100011010aaaa1111 000000aaaa00000000111000 0 # jl r1 (Taken)
xxx100011010aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jl r1 (Skip)
x01100011011aaaa1111 000000aaaa00000000111000 0 # jle r1 (Taken)
x10100011011aaaa1111 000000aaaa00000000111000 0 # jle r1 (Taken) 
xxx100011011aaaa1111 000000000000000001111000 1 # jle r1 (Skip)
